card.name: Warnings about driving and machinery
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas right before a mention of driving, operating machinery or hazardous tasks, in sections about drowsiness, dizziness or blurred vision.

modes.label: Link before driving or machinery
modes.description: A word like to, for, in, about or regarding that leads into driving, machinery or hazardous activities.
